costEstimating.title: Cost Estimating
costEstimating.description: Directly link your model measurements with your price databases. This integration allows you to generate accurate budgets immediately, helping you evaluate the financial impact of every decision from the initial phases.

modelAudit.title: Automatic Model Audit
modelAudit.description: Using automatic rules, MAMBA verifies the correct definition of the BIM model, detecting inconsistencies and information errors. Reinforce the quality and consistency of project data.

wasteCalculation.title: Automatic Waste Calculation
wasteCalculation.description: Determine the volume of waste associated with each construction element starting from your model data. MAMBA facilitates compliance with environmental regulations and optimizes resource logistics, allowing you to carry out projects that are more efficient and responsible with the environment.
